data.title: Body & Health — Starter · Lesson 4
data.subject: body
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
Here we go…

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?
Let's meet our new neighbors today.
Body and health… Cuerpo y salud
Words to learn… Palabras para aprender
Join the song, let's play.

[Verse]
Waving hands… Manos saludando
Meeting friends… Conociendo amigos
I have a broken arm… Tengo el brazo roto
My ankle hurts… Me duele el tobillo
Say it with me, now you know.
I have a sore throat… Tengo la garganta inflamada
My hand itches… Me pica la mano
Feel the rhythm, let it flow.

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?
Let's meet our new neighbors today.
Body and health… Cuerpo y salud
Words to learn… Palabras para aprender
Join the song, let's play.

[Verse]
I have an ear infection… Tengo una infección en el oído
My hip hurts when I walk… Me duele la cadera al caminar
I have dry skin… Tengo la piel seca
My wrist hurts when I write… Me duele la muñeca al escribir
Learning together, it's alright.
The head… La cabeza
The arm… El brazo
